column1: # note: Line 46: "Multiply line 45 by 2.5% (.025) and enter the result." A flat rate, so one bracket for each filing status Form 140 has.
# note: Form 140 has no qualifying surviving spouse status; such a filer files as head of household (Box 5), so qss is not listed.
# note: The instructions say to round every amount to the nearest whole dollar and not to enter cents (page 4, Tips for Preparing Your Return); the test rounds line 46 so.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
